answer: Couples can just keep jumping into bigger fights because putting energy into resolving each problem once is more efficient than working on smaller day-to-day slights. Sharing a bed is usually just one more item to push on the list, so sleeping apart will feel fresh and free up valuable time. If one partner dares not to think about or mention the problems every single day, that alone should unlock the couple’s potential for happiness, because the relationship becomes lightened.
